1. ART CLUB — You do not need to draw well to join. Bring a pencil; we give you the paper.

2. MUSIC ROOM — You can practise the piano after school. Please shut the door to keep the noise inside.

3. PHOTOGRAPHY WALK — Meet behind the school at four. Bring your own camera; no computer is needed.

4. Hi Max, I cannot go to the cinema tonight. Can we see the same cartoon on Saturday instead? Amy

5. DANCE CLUB — Please tidy up the room after practice. Put the chairs back and wash your hands before your snack.

6. THEATRE TICKETS — School play: Friday at six. Tickets are free, but ask at the office before Thursday.
